note: Forbidden: honouring an LLGR capability that arrives without GR. TestHandleEventOpenLLGR_NoGR sends an OPEN with code 71 and no code 64 and fails if peerLLGRCaps holds the peer (assert.False llgrOK). Negative: the same OPEN with code 64 keeps the decoded LLGR capability (Families, F bit, LLST 3600 asserted), so the removal is conditional on GR being absent.
